purpose: Historically invalid or superseded SR numerical routes. The SR kernel must not be able to call these, accidentally or otherwise. Enforced by tests/test_route_exclusion.py (AST + source scan).

routes.what: Handing the degree-120/121 closed-form series (h_1, rho_1) to the kernel/composition path.
routes.why_invalid: Catastrophic blow-up: complexity is (deg_p+1)*(deg_m+1)*(z_degree_after+1); a degree-120 argument explodes the product and the discard bound.
routes.correct_route: Low-degree (<=12) dyadic/Chebyshev candidate as the kernel argument; the closed form retained ONLY as a separate certification reference.

routes.what: Composing to full degree in the mixed variable u = alpha + zeta and truncating the patch-local variable once at the end.
routes.why_invalid: Re-expanding u^n spreads alpha-mass binomially with p = H/rho = 0.2041; 98.23% of the certified delta_0 was surrendered to the discard bound.
routes.correct_route: Truncate the patch-local variable at EVERY product (Task1R repair); alpha-degree never exceeds D and the discard decays geometrically in H/R.

routes.evidence: SR_DERIVATION.md section 5; frozen refine.py rationale (unrefined chain gives M_R2 = 6.2e4, B_cover = 143% of .050)
routes.what: Substituting the whole-cell drift interval [e_lo, e_hi] directly for e inside the resolvent/kernel and reading off the result.
routes.why_invalid: Sound but unusably wide: the dependency on e is entered many times and the interval is not refined, so the whole-cell envelope blows past B_cover.
routes.correct_route: Midpoint candidate + certified derivative + explicit refinement wiring; whole-cell width enters only through the order-2 envelope.

routes.why_invalid: Sound but a factor (k+1) looser than the Gaussian-structure bound.

routes.why_invalid: Knife edge: headroom +3.21e-16, the check is decided by rounding. Gate-2E FAIL.
routes.correct_route: Asymmetric pair P1_RULE_TARGET = (1-EPS_P1)*P1_CHECK_THRESHOLD with MIN_HEADROOM_REL guard (Gate-2F, inherited by Task1R).

routes.why_invalid: Failed its representation guard. Gate-2D remains FAIL, permanently and unrewritten.
routes.correct_route: Gate-2F representation guard (bidegree 16, complexity score bounded).

routes.what: Charging a derivative-order-1/2 term to a value channel (B_candidate/B_kernel/B_rounding/B_interval).
routes.why_invalid: The defect the cover-ledger successor exists to repair (old C*delta_dF against B_candidate).
routes.correct_route: Derivative orders charge only DERIVATIVE_OWNERS; enforced by the frozen depgraph, which SR reuses unmodified.

routes.what: Implementing sup_e E_e[Rbar^2] (the P5X theorem-consumer scalar M_2) as if it were the K1 cover obligation M_R2.
routes.why_invalid: Different quantity. K1 requires M_R2 = mag(R2_interval) >= sup_{e in cell} |R''_{D,m}(e)|. Substituting M_2 leaves every K1 cover obligation undischarged while appearing to succeed.
routes.correct_route: M_R2 from the order-2 assembly of H_r and W''_{r,j}, uniformly on the cell.
